🍠 When to plant cassava in Nigeria

Also called Ẹ̀gẹ́ / Gbaguda (Yoruba), Rogo (Hausa) and Akpụ (Igbo).

Quick answer: Plant cassava in Nigeria from March to June and September to October and harvest from all year round. Stems are planted at the start of the rains (March–June) or late rains (September–October). Roots are ready 9–18 months later.

About cassava

Nigeria is the world's largest cassava producer. It becomes garri, fufu (akpu), lafun and starch.

How to plant cassava well

Roots spoil 2–3 days after harvest. Process into garri or flour quickly.

Stems are planted at the start of the rains (March–June) or late rains (September–October). Roots are ready 9–18 months later.

Diseases and pests of cassava

  • Cassava mosaic diseasePlant clean stems of resistant varieties (e.g. TME 419) and uproot infected plants.
  • Cassava bacterial blightUse disease-free cuttings and rotate fields.

Best states for cassava

Benue · Kogi · Ogun · Oyo · Enugu · Imo · Cross River · Akwa Ibom · Delta · Ondo · Taraba · Nasarawa

Questions farmers ask

When is the best time to plant cassava in Nigeria?

Plant cassava in Nigeria from March to June and September to October and harvest from all year round. Stems are planted at the start of the rains (March–June) or late rains (September–October). Roots are ready 9–18 months later.

What is cassava called in Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo?

Cassava is called Ẹ̀gẹ́ / Gbaguda (Yoruba), Rogo (Hausa) and Akpụ (Igbo).

When is cassava harvested in Nigeria?

Cassava is usually harvested from all year round.

Which Nigerian states grow the most cassava?

Benue, Kogi, Ogun, Oyo, Enugu, Imo, Cross River, Akwa Ibom, Delta, Ondo, Taraba and Nasarawa are among the best-known cassava states.

Can I grow cassava in my part of Nigeria?

Yes. Cassava grows in every region of Nigeria: North and South.

What diseases attack cassava and how do I prevent them?

Cassava mosaic disease: Plant clean stems of resistant varieties (e.g. TME 419) and uproot infected plants. Cassava bacterial blight: Use disease-free cuttings and rotate fields.
